# Support

Thanks for using markdown. Here is how to get help.

## Before you ask

- Read the [README](../README.md) and the [godoc examples](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/nao1215/markdown); every exported symbol has one.
- Search the [existing issues](https://github.com/nao1215/markdown/issues); your question may already be answered.

## Where to ask

- Bug: open a [Bug report](https://github.com/nao1215/markdown/issues/new?template=bug-report.md).
- Feature idea: open a [Feature request](https://github.com/nao1215/markdown/issues/new?template=feature-request.md).

When reporting a problem, include the library version, the Go code that produces the output, and what the output should have been. For a mermaid diagram, the generated block and a screenshot of how GitHub renders it help most.

## Security

Do not report security issues in public issues. Follow the [Security Policy](../SECURITY.md).
